evals.prompt: Add UUID generation for client-side message ids in an MDE component.
evals.expected_output: Uses the native platform primitive instead of writing or installing an id generator, and states the rung it stopped at.
expectations: chooses crypto.randomUUID() over a custom or third-party generator
names the rung it stopped at
leaves one runnable check only if the logic is non-trivial

evals.prompt: Add a safety checker that blocks production database migrations from being applied from the wrong git state.
evals.expected_output: Inspects what the Supabase CLI actually does before encoding any rule, rather than inventing a heuristic about git.
expectations: reads the official CLI implementation or --help before writing the rule
records a source receipt with a destination and a verification command
separates source proof from implementation proof
does not treat a passing unit test as proof of documented CLI behaviour

evals.prompt: Build a modal dialog for the rentals filters panel.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the installed component library or an existing MDE component rather than hand-rolling focus trapping and keyboard navigation.
expectations: searches existing MDE components and the installed UI package first
checks the official component recipe before writing an equivalent
writes custom code only for MDE-specific behaviour
verifies with a focused test or a Playwright check

evals.prompt: Copy the current CopilotKit v2 streaming example into an MDE chat route.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the CopilotKit version pinned in this repository before adapting a current upstream example.
expectations: checks the installed version before copying the example
prefers versioned docs or repository source at the matching commit
does not apply a current upstream API to an older pinned version
